chunks.text: Today, we will talk about Haiti.
Haiti is a Caribbean country with a rich culture, strong people, and beautiful nature.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Haiti?
Haiti is on the island of Hispaniola in the Caribbean Sea.
It shares the island with the Dominican Republic.
Haiti is close to Cuba, Jamaica, and Puerto Rico.
It has mountains, coastlines, and tropical forests.
What is the capital city of Haiti?
The capital city is Port -au -Prince.
It is the largest city in Haiti.
It is next to the sea and has markets, museums, and government buildings.
Other cities include Caphaean in the north, Les Cailles in the south, Jackmel known for art and festivals.
How many people live in Haiti?
More than 11 million people live in Haiti.
Most people live in cities or villages near the coast.
Haitians are known for their strength, creativity, and community spirit.
What language do people speak in Haiti?
Haiti has two official languages.
Haitian Creole, Creole Aïsien, spoken by almost everyone, French, used in schools, government, and newspapers.
Many people also understand a little English or Spanish, especially in tourist areas.
What is the weather like in Haiti?
Haiti has a tropical climate.
It is usually hot and sunny.
There are two seasons.
The rainy season from April to October.
The dry season from November to March.
Hurricanes can happen between August and October.
What does Haiti look like?
Haiti has mountains.
The name Haiti means land of high mountains, beaches and bays, rivers, waterfalls and forests, fertile land for farming.
It is a country of natural beauty and history.
What animals live in Haiti?
In Haiti, you can see goats, pigs, chickens and cows in villages, frogs, lizards and birds in nature, crabs, fish and turtles by the sea.
Some special birds, like the Hispaniola and Trogon, live only on this island.
What do people eat in Haiti?
Haitian food is flavorful, spicy and homemade.
People eat rice and beans, a common meal, fried plantains, chicken, pork or fish, vegetables, cassava and cornmeal.
Popular dishes, griot, fried pork with seasoning, dairy at John John, rice with black mushrooms, soup Jumu, pumpkin soup eaten on Independence Day.
Toss out fried goat meat.
What do people drink in Haiti?
People drink water, fresh fruit juice, mango, papaya, passion fruit, coconut water, coffee strong and sweet.
Cremas a sweet drink with milk and spices for holidays.
Haitian drinks are often natural and homemade.
What is life like in Haiti?
Life in Haiti can be hard, but it is full of hope and culture.
People enjoy spending time with family, going to church, singing and dancing, working in markets or farms, helping neighbors.
Many people are artists, musicians or craft workers.
What are some holidays and traditions in Haiti?

Independence Day, January 1st, Haiti became free in 1804, carnival with music, costumes and parades, flag day, May 18th, Easter, Christmas and All Saints Day, Vodou ceremonies, a spiritual tradition with music and rhythm.
People wear colorful clothes, play drums and celebrate with joy.
Some fun facts about Haiti.
Haiti was the first Black Republic and the first independent country in Latin America.
The Haitian flag is blue and red with a symbol in the center.
Haitians love music like Compa, Rara and Tubabadu.
Haiti is famous for metal art, painting and poetry.
Many Haitians live outside Haiti.
This is called the Haitian diaspora.
Now you know many things about Haiti.
You know where it is, what people speak and what they eat.
You learned about the land, the traditions and daily life.
Great job.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
